crossRefs.note: When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath Lehi.
But God split the hollow place that is in Lehi, and water came out of it. When he had drunk, his spirit came again, and…

people.name: Lehi
people.line: A place where Samson fought the Philistines

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: Then the Philistines went up, encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
translations.bsb: Then the Philistines went up, camped in Judah, and deployed themselves near the town of Lehi.
translations.kjv: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
translations.asv: Then the Philistines went up, and encamped in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
